consultations.title: Kanyama Drainage Upgrade Project Consultation
consultations.summary: Lusaka City Council is collecting public input on flood-control design, relocation support, and construction phasing for Kanyama drainage upgrades.
consultations.feedbackPrompt: What is your overall view on this project?

consultations.title: Public Notice: Agricultural to Residential Land Use Conversion
consultations.summary: The Council and Ministry seek comments on converting a designated agricultural tract to mixed residential use with utilities and roads.
consultations.issuerName: Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources
consultations.feedbackPrompt: How do you feel about the proposed land-use conversion?

consultations.title: National Citizen Input: eGovernment Service Charter 2027
consultations.summary: Cabinet Office is gathering citizen feedback on service standards, turnaround times, and grievance handling across ministries and councils.
consultations.feedbackPrompt: Which direction should the 2027 charter prioritize?
